Saved Views is available today, giving every user a faster way to work with the lists that matter most. Instead of rebuilding filters, sorting, and grouping each time you open a project, you can now capture the exact configuration you rely on and return to it in a single click. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every team already subscribed can start using it right away at no extra cost.

Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from a daily priority list to a quarterly reporting snapshot. Once a view is set up, it can be shared with a team, so teammates see the same filters and layout without recreating them from scratch. This keeps everyone aligned on how work gets organized and cuts down on time spent explaining setup steps to new members.

We built this feature based on direct customer feedback, and we think it will make daily planning noticeably easier. Give it a try and tell us what you think.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
